reviews.text:
We have used Pirate Island Pool Service for several years and we are beyond happy with the experience. The office staff is very communicative and consistently demonstrates well-executed methods for handling maintenance, service, and billing. Chace Harmon is quick to answer the phone and get our concern directed to the right person. When one of our valves broke last summer, Tiffany Bonas, Director of Operations, responded within a few hours and gave us, in writing, several options to address the issue. Thomas, in maintenance came out within 24 hours and showed us what he was going to do and why. We then received a Service Ticket Complete report that included photos. The whole company makes things convenient and transparent for their customers.
We adore our pool tech Bobby Gray—he is always on time, always has a smile, and is incredibly thorough in keeping our pool sparkling week after week. After each visit he sends an email with a list of services he performed such as checking chlorine and pH levels, pressure gauge reading and that he closed the gate!
To top off, he loves our dog and she loves him!
We've also found that other technicians from Pirate Island are equally professional and attentive whenever they visit, which speaks to the company's consistently high standards.
Thank you, Pirate Island, for all you do for us! 5 stars!
reviews.author: Marianne Rayermann

reviews.text: After trying several pool service companies over several years, we started with Pirate Island Pools several years ago. They have been great! Very reliable service, great communication, address any issues in a very timely manner. Our pool looks better than it ever has.  Our service technician, Zach, is great. Very friendly, professional and reliable.  I would not hesitate to recommend Pirate Island Pools to anyone.  You will not be disappointed!
reviews.author: Dave Napier

reviews.text: We have been with Pirate Island Pools for a few years now.  We have had an excellent experience with them. Their technician Dennis goes above and beyond. He takes great care of our pool and a bonus, our dog loves when he comes for our weekly maintenance! Pirate Island is very good with communication as well. Highly recommend them to anyone!
reviews.author: Lone Star Styles

reviews.text: Tried 3 other companies before switching over to pirate. It seemed like one company knew how to handle service well but not able to fix anything and another would just charge an arm and a leg for any and everything. Pirate spends the needed time on service, my pool looks great and they have been able to diagnose and fix issues as they have popped up. Most of my experience has been through Daniel Kent there so if you are wanting to duplicate my experience maybe ask for him. Great company!
reviews.author: Joel Webb

reviews.text:
I have lived in my house for over 20 years and had at least 8-9 pool companies in that time, but finally found one that is worth the price.

Pirate Island do what they say and say what the do, and if something isn't right they make it right and take responsibility.

I no longer worry if my pool cleaner is showing up or not this week and have never had a cloudy pool that wasn't super nice to swim in.

Our tech Zach has been on our route and he does a great job and always has a smile and a friendly word to say.

From top of management to the field techs, they take the time to make sure the customer experience is "old school done right".
reviews.author: Paul Straten

reviews.text: Been with Pirate Island for a few years, both for my residence pool and my work pool, and they have been great. Easy to work with, good value and pool is done every week to the highest standards. We have never had a single issue with them or their services. My wife and I would wholeheartedly recommend.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Treibs

reviews.text: We have happily used Pirate Island Pool for all service and repairs on our pool and have been very happy with their services. Great service, communication and follow through on everything they do for us and we would recommend them highly. Dennis is our weekly service tech and he is very helpful, prompt and friendly.
reviews.author: Scott Windle

reviews.text: I’ve been using PIP for 3 years, and I couldn’t be happier with their service! Our pool has never looked better. A special shout-out to Joe, who is always professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. They take the time to explain what’s needed and make sure everything is running perfectly. It’s clear they care about their work and customers. I highly recommend PIP if you’re looking for reliable, top-notch pool maintenance!
reviews.author: Claire Liu

reviews.text: Have used Pirate Island Pool for several years. They provide consistently excellent maintenance service as well as diagnostic and repair resources as needed. Joe, in particular, does a great job and is very informative. Fairly priced and quickly respond to concerns. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Les Smith

reviews.text:
Appreciate Joe @ Pirate Island Pools so much! He treats my pool like his own! Shares all the knowledge, tips and tricks to keep us clean and beautiful year-round. And such a nice guy!

Previous pool company was a joke compared to PIP. Thanks Joe and Pirate Island Pools!
reviews.author: Dorothy Romero

reviews.text: While I'd been trying to clean the pool myself all spring, my husband finally convinced me to go with a service, so I could focus on swimming in the pool instead! (I know I know...but I didn't realize how much work it was!). While we pay a tiiiiny bit more for Pirate Island Pools, we both agree the extra few dollars are really worth it! The pool looks amazing, cleanings are always on time, if anything big needs to be replaced they show us what they're looking at before-hand, the servicemen are polite and knowledgeable and the office is always responsive. We couldn't be happier! :D
reviews.author: Tiffany Hoover

reviews.text: We have used Pirate Island Pools for more than 10 years.  Have always been happy with their service of keeping our pool clean and algae free – they’re also very prompt on repairs, service or other issues we have had with our pool. Would definitely recommend their company.
reviews.author: Judy Corley

reviews.text: Pirate Pools & their team has been serving our pool for the last 5+ years.  The service and expertise has been amazing whenever we’ve had questions and/or assistance with a pool concern.  Bobby, who  services our pool each week has always been prompt with his schedule as well as reminders when something is needed.  Thank you Pirate Pools & Bobby!
reviews.author: T Fisher

reviews.text:
The best pool company in the area.. Our pool always looks crystal blue. Our pool guy Joe is excellent. He takes great care of our pool and makes sure our equipment is in top shape.
Highly recommend Pirate Island Pools.
reviews.author: Ray Empkey

reviews.text: Pirate Island Pools provides very good service, knowledgeable tech, timely and responsive service. Joe Harrington who services our pool does a great job. He is kind, great attitude and provides good pool service.
reviews.author: Rose Campbell

reviews.text: Joe does an amazing job cleaning our pool.  The water is crystal clear and there is never any moss or discoloration. Joe was over by my pool equipment and noticed that there was water under the equipment that shouldn’t be there.  He figured out where the leak was and reported it.  Luckily, Thomas was able to come out and fix the leak before the cold weather hit. I appreciate the kern eye shoe keeps on our equipment.  We truly appreciate how great our pool always looks and how everybody is so friendly and how each of them pays attention to details.  Thanks again.
reviews.author: Jennifer Winmill

reviews.text: They do a great job. I’ve used them for weekly pool service for a few years now and never had an issue. Very reliable and Bobby has also done a great job.
reviews.author: matt sage

reviews.text: We have used Pirate Island Pools for quite a few years. They have always been attentive when we have had issues. Bobby is great.
reviews.author: Ingrid Ford

reviews.text: We have been customers of Pirate Island Pools for over a decade.  Our pool can be difficult to balance with all of our trees, but our current tech, Dwaine, is amazing.  Since taking on our weekly service, about 3 years ago, our pool has been perfect!  He is the best tech we have had in over 25 years.  I would recommend him to anyone needing great service for their pool.  Thanks and two thumbs up to Dwaine!  We appreciate Pirate Island Pools and the service they provide.
reviews.author: Susan Pippin

reviews.text: I have been a customer since Pirate Island Pools started. They have outstanding professional, knowledgeable pool techs. Always quick to respond to requests and issues. My pool constantly looks great. Owner, Juli is hands on and will go out of her way to make sure her customers are happy and satisfied. I am one of PIP's many satisfied customers.
reviews.author: Susan Beatty

reviews.text:
I initially contacted this company when I say their awesome painted car driving around our town.  Their driver rolled down is window and thanked me for stopping him, giving me Julie's name to contact. I called Julie and she got us set up immediately.

OUTSTANDING company.  EXCELLENT service.  They do a GREAT job staying on top of everything needed to proactively maintain our pool to avoid breakdown, unnecessary repairs, etc., i.e. filter changes, etc.  They are VERY consistent with regular service, even during high season and holidays.  They respond quickly to all service needs and get it done timely.

We have had ZERO issues with our pool since transitioning to their service.  Their office is excellent to work with regarding invoices, billing, etc.  Ask for Julie, she has always helped us with anything we needed.

Their rates are very competitive combined with their excellent customer service...makes this a TOP NOTCH company.

HIGHLY recommend this company.
reviews.author: Cool Cat

reviews.text:
We moved into our home about 2 months ago . I called a couple of companies but Pirate called me back quickly I told them I needed someone to look at the heater also the pump for the waterfall and to qoute me to service the pool . When they came they were professional
and knowledgeable . Did not try to sell me at all just explained to me and showed me what needed to be done . They gave me a fair price on replacing my heater also replacing the pump to the waterfall . everything is working Great. also want to add the young man that comes to my house every week to service the pool does a great job and is very thorough could not be more pleased . Also want to say the office staff is always great to talk to always positive and helpful .
Needless to say I highly recommend this company.

Alan Downs
reviews.author: Alan Downs

reviews.text: My pool pump quick working two Sunday's ago and I called my regular pool company on Monday who informed me they could not come for ten days.  I contacted Julie Gerrard at Pirate Island Pools who stated she could make my repairs in two days. Her technician arrived on Monday afternoon and took care of my problem. I will certainly be using them again! Same day service!
reviews.author: Jim Griffith

reviews.text: After trying many different pool companies with no success, we tried Pirate Island Pools.  They were exactly what we needed.  They finally got our pool clear and beautiful.  They have been faithful in coming out each week.  All of their employees are polite, friendly, and willing to answer any questions you may have.  I would recommend them to all of my friends!
reviews.author: Sarah White

reviews.text: Carlos did an amazing job. He cleans our pool. He is always on time, and very professional every week.
reviews.author: Alysa Thomas

reviews.text: I use Pirate Island Pools to clean and add chemicals to my pool weekly. They are very professional and I know I can always depend on them to answer questions and the pool will be sparkling when they leave. I had my filter cleaned yesterday and not only did they do a thorough job but Bobby, my always friendly technician, picked up a dead squirrel in the yard that the dogs had just killed and took it away. As a single female, he has no idea how appreciative I was!!! With or without the squirrel event, I would highly recommend Pirate Island Pools.
reviews.author: Laura Dearing

reviews.text: We've used PIP for several years now for our routine weekly pool service and have been completely satisfied - always receiving before/after pictures and thorough details of the weekly maintenance. All we had to do was enjoy the pool. Most recently, during SNOVID 2021, and the power outage for over 36 hours, we lost ALL of our pool equipment, and Juli and her team came through for us immediately, especially since we'd just sold our home and heading to closing. Caring professsionals who treat their customers like family! Highly recommend. - Pat
reviews.author: Pat Fleming

reviews.text: Joe is our dedicated pool service guy. He does an amazing job. He always keeps me informed of the trend of my pool
reviews.author: Osme Benedict

reviews.text: Consistent, Courteous, Competent! Dennis our technician is A+++++. 5 years have been using Pirate Island Pools.
reviews.author: Tamara Ratigan

reviews.text: I reached out to Pirate Island during the Feb freeze.  Thomas (technician) and Julie (owner) both provided "top notch service".  Specifically the  communication (regular phone calls from Julie to provide updates and scheduling) and with Thomas who didn't over diagnose the problem..... explained to me what he was doing to get things back running....and told me he would be back the following day to re-evaluate.   You both were outstanding with each one of those commitments. My initial call was during the freeze in Feb and I can only imagine how busy you were, yet you took the time to respond within 4 hrs and give me realistic expectations on service.  I would absolutely recommend Pirate Island Pools to others! 5*+
reviews.author: Richard Grathwohl

reviews.text: I highly recommend this company for any of your pool needs. I recently had a leak and Cory came over the same day to fix it. I will definitely use them again and am so pleased with the customer service that I will begin using them for weekly pool cleaning. PIP is worth every $ spent. You may find services for cheaper at other places but you will not find great customer service and quality of work like you would by using PIP.
reviews.author: Daniel Bernal

reviews.text: I was referred to Julie at Pirate Island Pools to fix my spa heater when it went out and i had 6 people coming to stay with me.  Both Julie and her technician far exceeded my expectations in responsive and service. They went above and beyond driving to Plano to get my heater to be sure I had it in time.  They definitely under promised but  over delivered!!
reviews.author: Esther Spina

reviews.text: I can’t recommend Pirate Island Pools enough. They’ve always been kind, responsive and helpful. After the big winter freeze in DFW destroyed my entire pool pump and DE filter, they were out to do an estimate within days of things thawing out and completed a full repair incredibly fast. This is particularly noteworthy given the sheer volume of work and parts required throughout DFW right now. Kudos to a great company!
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.text: Pirate Pools is the single greatest pool company I have ever worked with.  Corey at Pirate Pools regularly goes above and beyond the call of duty to make sure we are satisfied customers.  Most recently, I returned home to an issue with our pool that needed to be addressed.  Disclaimer: it was 7 pm on a Friday night.  Corey called me immediately within 2 minutes of texting Andy calling him and helped walk me through what to do to address the issue. After we could not determine how to address the issue, Corey had a service technician come to our house to get the issue addressed...again all within 15 minutes of my call on a Friday night.  I cannot say enough good things about Pirate Pools and would likely never use another pool company.  Lucas Barton
reviews.author: Lucas Barton

reviews.text: We recently moved to Soutlake Texas and purchased a home with an older pool that needed updating. Pirate Island was recommended to us and they helped us identify a great contractor to refinish the pool and Pirate Island installed 2 new heaters. Thomas handled the heater installation and did a great job handling some complications of wiring up 2 heater units and Corey spent almost 2 hours with us helping us understand all the equipment and operating instructions. We came away from the experience with a great feeling about the quality of the work and service of this company and have chosen them also for our monthly services. Finally the owner of the company Juli Gerrard called us upon completion to ask for feedback which demonstrates the company’s committment to customer service in my opinion. Mike and DeeAnne Barton
reviews.author: Dee Anne Barton

reviews.text: I think they do a great job on maintaining and caring for my pool. Cory Johnson came by today and helped me with a problem and made an improvement on my Polaris set up. They are always ready to help. I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Tommy Braddy

reviews.text: Pirate Island had done a great job taking care of our pool. We just moved to a new house and we needed service fast. They were on-site on 3 days and had pool clean and us on schedule. Great job.
reviews.author: Jason Compton

reviews.text: Pirate Island Pools is reliable and do a great job maintaining our pools. Derek is the best!
reviews.author: Stacie Duke- Tierney

reviews.text: Service has been very professional, reliable and friendly. Joe Harrington does a fabulous job and is super friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend this service.
reviews.author: Christiaan Lohler

reviews.text: No show, very late call. Thomas was scheduled for this last Wednesday. He was supposed to call sometime in the early afternoon while he was heading over. I adjusted my schedule to make sure I was home for him. I received a text at 4:45pm that said he was out sick. They should have let me know as soon as they knew. Which leads me to suspect that "sick" was just a made up story. Whatever. Thx for wasting my time
reviews.author: Alekzandr Apokalypto

reviews.text: We are very pleased with the service we receive from Pirate Island Pools.  They got our pool up and running quickly after the big snowstorm.  We’ve used them for over 5 years.  Would recommend to others.
reviews.author: Julie Thayer

reviews.text: This is the pool company you can trust. They stand behind their service and always communicate with you about anything you have questions. They fixed a leaking pipe around 4 months ago. The pipe started to leak. I asked the company about warranty and they fixed it for free even though the warranty usually covers one month. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: 李丰

reviews.text: The team at PIP is simply the best.  Everyone from Thomas in the field to Tiffany in the office the entire team is terrific.  They make owning a pool a joy and even when we are away for an extended period, their technology and service is so good we don't worry at all about the pool, even in tough weather conditions.  This is the ONLY group to handle a pool in this market.
reviews.author: Michael Sicuro

reviews.text: I was charged a service fee for the worker to hook a wire back up on my pump and he stated that fixed it.  Yet it was already working just not enough because as I found out from another company it was clogged.  Then I was told that they wold not perform weekly service because my plumbing was too old, did not know 3 years was too old for pool plumbing.  I am sure that it was actually the 5 trees around the pool that makes it a little more work and had nothing to do with the plumbing.  So if you have an easy pool that never requires anything extra this is the company for you.
reviews.author: Kristal Spooner

reviews.text: Dennis with Pirate Island Pools is outstanding.  We have been greatly impressed with the entire Pilot Islands team!
reviews.author: John B

reviews.text: Always responsive, professional, efficient, and cost aware.  Very customer focused and easy to work with.  We’ve worked with a few pool companies, and Pirate Island is the best.
reviews.author: Tatiana Wicke

reviews.text: Pirate Island treats our pool like it is their pool.Dwaine does a great job every week taking care of our pool.
reviews.author: 76FLYGAL

reviews.text: Great Experience.  Pirate Island Pools upgraded our pool.  Some items did not work out as planned, but the crew did not give up.  I was impressed with their customer service and hard work.
reviews.author: Kirk Moore

reviews.text:
Pirate Pools took great care of my pool in a timely way!  Very reliable, professional and friendly!
I highly recommend them for pool services!
reviews.author: Kay Allen

reviews.text: Joe is awesome! Very knowledgeable and thorough. PIP is responsive and easy to work with.
reviews.author: Aaron Sheffield

reviews.text: Pirate Island provides the best service I’ve seen in 25 years of being a pool owner. I highly recommend them - friendly, knowledgeable staff and excellent service.
reviews.author: Laura Thomas

reviews.text: Pirate Island does a great job being proactive and responsive. My tech, Zach, does a great job. Very happy with their work.
reviews.author: Joe Rubio

reviews.text: Our pool is sparkling with our guy Dennis. Pirate pools wants to make sure their customer is happy and they make it right. I def recommend them!!
reviews.author: Mrs Mallory

reviews.text: Great and fast service.  Pool had an algae bloom which old pool service did not catch / control.  Pirate Island took care of it at the first visit.  Pool now looks great.
reviews.author: William Tower

reviews.text:
Great service
Very responsive, reliable and they do great work
Pool always looks great!
reviews.author: Dan Davis

reviews.text: Pirate Island Pools are fantastic. We have been using them for many many years!  They are always prompt and professional!
reviews.author: Carol Horton

reviews.text: Our experience with Pirate Island Pools has been fantastic.  Great, knowledgeable workers with a "can do" attitude.  Thank you!!!
reviews.author: John Miller

reviews.text: They did a great job on our pool. They were very helpful in advising the proper service plan for general maintenance. I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Eric Fontaine

reviews.text: Love this place!  I’ve been through several different pool companies and this is the best.  They are now my go-to pool company.  I’m a realtor and will recommend to my clients.
reviews.author: Kristen Graves

reviews.text: I highly recommend Pirate Island Pools!  They are always very professional and quick to respond!!  Being a realtor, I would highly recommend them to my clients!
reviews.author: Barbara Pantuso

reviews.text: really good service, never had any complaints about my pool & hot tub from my customers.staff also very helpful who can understand customer's needs.
reviews.author: motel6 4641

reviews.text: Our tech is quite and discreet you hardly know he is there and they have been so patient with us as new pool owners.
reviews.author: DeLynn Miller

reviews.text:
Very Professional and Incredible customer service from Management to the Pool Techs.
Could Not be happier ...Love Pirate Island Pools !!
reviews.author: Brandi Albaugh

reviews.text: Had many problems from previous pool service Pirate Island was quick and kept me informed at every step to correct the pool.
reviews.author: BJ Prior

reviews.text: Someone in one of your vehicles was endangering the lives of everyone on Western Center BLVD this morning, by driving close to 100mph when taking off from lights and weaving in and out of traffic. Not a great way to advertise your business by having an employee or higher drive like a mad man this morning.
reviews.author: Brian T

reviews.text: Very responsive and dependable. Have used them for a long time now.
reviews.author: Angela Bowers

reviews.text: I have used Pirate Island Pools for over a year and service has been great.
reviews.author: James M (Animations)

reviews.text: Employees are very professional, knowledgeable, and dependable. Highly recommend Pirate Island Pools!
reviews.author: Karen Deakin

reviews.text: They were on time and even came back to fix a problem that I had!  Amazing!  Would recommend them to everyone!!

reviews.text: Thank you Thomas!!! Fixed my spa yesterday couldn’t be happier with him and Pirate Island.

reviews.text: Great service! Bobby is the best!

reviews.text: Pirate Island Pools constantly provides excellent service and outstanding maintenance support!

reviews.text: They did an awesome job, we were very happy with there work.

reviews.text: Quick to respond, prompt service and great customer service. I would use them again and highly recommend this company.

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high volume of detailed, positive reviews from long-term customers is a strong positive signal. Complaints are few, specific, and non-systemic (e.g., a single no-show incident, an old billing dispute, a driving complaint). The cluster of positive reviews from 10 months ago is a minor anomaly but not definitive proof of fakery given the otherwise authentic content.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted in the same month (10 months ago) could indicate a review push, but content is varied and specific.
authentic_signals: Extremely specific details: multiple technician names (Zach, Dennis, Joe, Daniel, Chace, Tiffany), specific roles, project types (maintenance, valve repair), and timelines.
Varied writing styles and perspectives from different customers.
Mix of praise and specific, credible complaints.
Owner responses are professional and address reviewers by name.
Long-term customer relationships frequently mentioned (several years).
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google and Yelp, both at 4.8 stars with similar review volumes.
